Name: Always Win Egg Hunt
Author: Putny
Description:
This is my first mod ever made so let me know if you run into errors!


It is a simple mod that just sets your egg count to 99 at for the egg hunt so you will always win.
I tested it once to see if it works and it does, I did not collect any eggs because I don't know if the game can read above 99 eggs so it would be best to not collect any.

Downloads.Description: Always win the egg festival, don't collect any eggs and still win! Copy file into your Stardew Valley Mods folder.

Manifest.Name: Always Win Egg Hunt
Manifest.Description: Guarantees you win the Egg Hunt by setting your score very high.
Manifest.Author: Putny
